goal: Validate Linux x86_64 installer adapters for required distro families.
description: Make installer adapter detection and prerequisite hints correct for Debian, Red Hat family, openSUSE, Arch family, and Alpine on x86_64. Alpine must use the musl platform key.

acceptance_criteria.text: Installer adapter smoke tests cover linux-x86_64 for Debian, Red Hat family, openSUSE, and Arch family.
Installer adapter smoke tests cover linux-musl-x86_64 for Alpine.

goal: Prove Linux glibc x86_64 real-machine build and workflow support.
description: Run native build, native tests, installer smoke, spio doctor, managed styio install, and clean project workflow smoke on Debian, Red Hat family, openSUSE, and Arch family x86_64 machines, with the same evidence format for each family.

acceptance_criteria.text: Debian, Red Hat family, openSUSE, and Arch family x86_64 machines each record build, test, install, doctor, managed styio, and workflow smoke evidence.
Distro prerequisite commands and runtime linkage notes are documented for apt, dnf, zypper, and pacman families.

acceptance_criteria.text: A musl x86_64 machine records build, test, install, doctor, managed styio, and workflow smoke evidence.
